decisions.reason: The same-message MODIFY already fully captures the high-speed splash-control condition and the stated mitigation options, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
Possible whisk-position adjustment is only a conditional splash-mitigation option and does not change the selected whisk design, material, or size requirements.

The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY for the 5200 RPM limit, noncontinuous maximum operation, and supported speed modes; the mixing-quality constraint adds no further speed-control state.
The client merely permits a future bowl-depth adjustment if necessary; no concrete depth or capacity change is selected, so the existing bowl geometry remains unchanged.
Smooth high-speed mixing concerns agitation inside the bowl and does not alter dispensing flow, froth preservation during dispensing, or the pour sequence.
The source decision does not change the solenoid valve or button-controlled dispensing behavior.
The high-speed mixing-quality condition does not modify the requirement that the bottom seal prevent liquid from reaching electronics.
The source decision does not change spout removal, flushing, or any other liquid-path cleaning behavior.
Approval of smooth operation across the higher motor-speed range does not change the required wiring-plan deliverable or its detail level.
The source decision concerns agitation behavior and optional splash mitigation, not spout removability or its cleaning purpose.
A possible future bowl-depth adjustment does not alter the requirement for easy bowl removal and rapid swapping.
The mixing-quality decision has no effect on placard text, placement, or viewing orientation.
